name: AH 3091
title: Allied Health Sciences Internship
description: Provides Allied Health students actual work experience in their area of concentration. Students work with professionals in their concentration to meet objectives consistent with their major. Students may only count a maximum combined credit total of six credits toward the Allied Health major of International Study, Independent Study and Internship credits. Students taking this course will be assigned a final grade of S (satisfactory) or U (unsatisfactory). May be repeated for credit.
requirement_description: Open to Department of Allied Health Sciences students; open to juniors or higher.
